Commentary.Commentary: The Windies bowling was way below par and they bowled 11 wides in the innings. If the Windies are to win this one and seal the series then they will have to bat very well. Join us for the Windies chase in a while.

Liton Das was in great touch and scored his 2nd T20I fifty. Das and Sarkar had a solid 58 run stand but both of them departed in quick succession. Mushfiqur Rahim didn't last long either. It looked like the Bangladesh innings would crumble down but their skipper, Shakib Al Hasan and Mahmudullah had other ideas and made an unbeaten 91 run stand in just 42 deliveries.

What a batting performance by Bangladesh. Liton Das started the innings all guns blazing and took the attack to the Windies bowlers. Tamim played second fiddle in the opening partnership. He got out in the 5th over when the score was 42 after looking rusty all along. Soumya Sarkar replaced him and continued the  run flow.

FOUR! What a way to finish the innings. Full toss on off stump and Mahmudullah just lofts it on the off side and to the left of deep cover for a boundary. The fielder has no chance there. Brilliant end to the innings for the hosts. Mahmudullah is looking for a no ball but the umpire is not interested and the innings comes to an end. BANGLADESH END ON 211/4 AFTER 20 OVERS.
Full and outside off, driven by Shakib through the covers for a single.
A play and a miss! Full toss outside off and Shakib tries to cheekily guide this away fine on the off side but misses the ball completely.
A half-volley but Mahmudullah can't connect properly this time and the ball drops just short of the long on fielder. He went to slog this over cow corner but doesn't hit it too well.
Full and outside off, driven hard but straight to cover who is deep at the edge of the circle. Hence the batsmen can run through for a single.
Full toss on middle, Shakib gets it away in the gap through mid-wicket while slogging. The batsmen come back for two by the time the ball is returned.
Keemo Paul to bowl the last over of the innings.
Outside off, Mahmudullah swings and misses.
Shakib has played it to the point region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Flicked off the pads by Mahmudullah to rotate the strike.
Wide. Once again down the leg side. Brathwaite struggling with this left hand and right hand combination. And the Windies are giving away a lot of free runs for the hosts.
Shorter on this occasion and the southpaw pulls it away for a single.
Fuller pitching outside leg, Mahmudullah tries to flick but gets an inside edge and on the pads for a run.
Down the leg side and the umpire signals it as wide.
Full toss outside off, Shakib chips it between mid off and extra cover for a single.

FOUR! Doesn't matter how they come as long as they come. The ball is on a length and Mahmudullah who goes for a pull, gets a top edge on it and the ball goes over the keeper's head for a boundary. 16 runs off this over and 55 off the last three.
Short and wide outside off, Shakib cuts it away hard for another single to deep point.
Full ball at the pads, flicked away wristily for a single.

FOUR! It is raining boundaries here and no Windies bowler can seem to stop the bleeding of runs. This one is full and wide outside off, the batsman just puts his bat out and guides it wide of the short third man fielder. The ball runs away for a boundary.
FOUR! This short ball is put away easily by the batsman. Mahmudullah gets into position very quickly and lifts it over short fine leg for yet another boundary. Great batting by Bangladesh.
Full length delivery to start off, Mahmudullah lofts it very high in the air over the bowler's head but luckily for him the ball lands in between long off and long on. The batsmen come back for two.
Oshane Thomas is back for his last over.

Good stop. Goes for another yorker. Serves it full on off, Mahmudullah makes room and drives it through covers. Rovman Powell in the deep runs to his right and stops it with his feet. Saves a run for his team. However, Bangladesh have managed to get 20 runs from this over.
Excellent yorker. Shakib does well to get bat to ball to the off side. They cross.
FOUR! Off the middle and Shakib is dealing in boundaries. Fuller ball around off, Shakib gets to the ball and lofts this over mid-wicket. Nobody there and the skipper continues to pile on runs.
FOUR! Lovely from Shakib. Full and on off, Shakib shuffles and flicks this over short fine leg. Another boundary results.
Wide! More sundries. Down the leg side, wide given by the umpire.
Full and on off, driven to mid off.
FOUR! Edge but a boundary. Back of a length ball outside off, Shakib gets an edge as the ball bounces a bit extra. It goes over the keeper's head to the third man boundary.
Wayward start. Errs this way down leg. Shakib leaves it alone. The keeper too cannot collect it. The ball rolls towards fine leg where they collect two more.
Keemo Paul is into the attack.

Very full and almost yorker length, Mahmudullah digs it out towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs. Very good running! End of a very good over for the hosts. 19 runs off it in the end. We see Evin Lewis getting some treatment on the hamstring area. Meanwhile, we also see a replay that shows us that the ball adjudged wide outside off stump in the over had a thin feather off the willow actually. But maybe the noise out there is too much and neither the umpire nor the fielders could hear the edge.
Full and on middle, pushed down the ground to mid on for a single.
Wide! Wide outside off, Shakib goes chasing but misses the ball. The umpire signals wide to this but the bowler is not pleased.
FOUR! Rank poor delivery from the bowler. On the pads, Shakib picks it up and puts it over the head of the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Full and outside off, Shakib drives it hard but this time it goes straight to the cover fielder.
SIX! Even worse now for the WI skipper. Half-volley on middle and Shakib lofts this one over mid-wicket and also over the fence. 11 runs off 2 balls in this over so far.
Wide! A bouncer, almost halfway down the track and the ball bounces over the head of the batsman. Immediately signaled wide by the umpire. The frustration is showing on Brathwaite's face.

FOUR LEG BYES! Oh my god! The ball has gone through the legs of Oshane Thomas and gone into the fence. The skipper isn't pleased. Full and on the pads, Shakib misses his flick, gets hit on the pads and the ball runs fine on the leg side. Shai Hope dives to his right but cannot get a hand to it. It should have been an easy stop for fine leg but Thomas doesn't come down in time and lets the ball run through.
Carlos Brathwaite to bowl his 3rd over.
Lofted in the air over cover but the ball falls well short of the fielder in the deep. It is an easy single. Shakib keeps the strike.
Wide ball down the leg side.
Yet another single towards sweeper cover. The ball was full and outside off with some good pace on it, and driven away to the deep.
Well outside off, Shakib hits it away to deep cover for the fourth consecutive single.
Another ball on middle, Mahmudullah rocks back and punches it through the gap to the sweeper cover for one.
Oooh! Good bounce there, almost climbed too much for Shakib to cut but he adjusts and pushes this short ball away on the off side for another run.
Flatter ball outside off, pushed away to deep cover for a single.
Fabian Allen returns for another over.
Single to end the over! Mahmudullah keeps strike. 13 runs from the over and a good one for the hosts.
Surprise! Two dot balls in a row. The ball is outside off and Mahmudullah fails to find the gap on the off side as he pushes this away to point.
Normalcy returns. The length ball on middle and off is played back towards the bowler with a straight bat from within the crease.

FOUR! And the strike rate is still the same! Cottrell comes over the wicket this time but the ball is served outside off, Mahmudullah cuts and finds the gap to the left of point and picks up another boundary. 12 off 3 now.
FOUR! Two in two! Fuller this time, and the batsman comes down the wicket and lofts it over cover on a bounce to the fence for another boundary. The strike rate remains.
FOUR! What a way to get off the mark! Short and outside off, Mahmudullah stands tall and cuts it away wide off the sweeper in the deep for another boundary. 400 strike rate.
Mahmudullah is in at number 6.

OUT! What a catch! Another very good catch. Fuller ball on middle, Rahim makes room to slog this away. Gets it off the bottom of the bat. The ball skies towards deep square leg where Allen settles himself under it and makes no mistake. Not easy those under the lights. Not much contribution this time from the pocket-size dynamite, Rahim.
Nice change of pace. Slower ball outside off, Rahim looks to guide it but cannot get bat to ball.
Slightly fuller on middle and leg, flicked towards mid-wicket for one.
Length ball on off, rushes onto Rahim. His bottom hand comes off the bat as the ball drops near him on the left side. They cross.
Around 141kph. Similar line and length, this time driven through mid off to give Rahim the strike.
FOUR! First boundary for Shakib. Full and outside off, Shakib hits it through the line and over the top of mid off for a boundary.
Mushfiqur Rahim is the new man in.

OUT! The off stump and middle stump are uprooted! Around the wicket, and the ball comes in with the angle after landing on off stump. Liton was looking to dab it down to third man but the ball had too much pace on it as it knocks off two stumps before the batsman could get his willow on the ball. The salutation comes out once more. Windies have two in an over and Bangladesh have to be careful not to lose way here.
Full and worked off his legs for a couple towards deep mid-wicket. Lovely shot though.

Fuller ball on middle, taken on the full and flicked straight to the square leg fielder. Shakib was backing up a bit too far and the fielder has a shy at the non-striker's end. The batsman was back in though.
Length ball on the pads, flicked away with the angle for a single.
Slower ball outside off, pushed down back to the bowler.
Shakib Al Hasan is the next batsman in at number 4.

OUT! Stunner! An absolute stunner here from the skipper! Slower ball short and outside off, Sarkar times this beautifully but in the air towards cover. The ball seemed to being going for four all along. But Braithwaite times his jump to perfection, gets his hand to the ball and parries it, and completes the catch on its way down, even as he falls down. What a piece of fielding, have to stand up and applaud.
Sheldon Cottrell back for his second spell.
Sarkar works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
SIX! Sweet! That came off the middle of the bat. Short ball on middle and leg, Sarkar comes down and hoicks this over square leg for a monster hit.
Rocks back and punches this ball to the off side to give his partner the strike.
Pitches this ball up outside off, guided to short third man for one.
Short again outside off, Liton rocks back and pulls it towards cow corner for another run.
Short ball down the leg side. Sarkar checks his pull as it goes behind short fine leg. They cross.
Single to end the over. Flatter ball on middle, Sarkar works it away calmly to deep square leg for a single and keeps strike. 16 runs off the over.
FOUR! Short and pulled away beautifully. Sarkar rocks back to this short ball on middle and deposits behind square on the leg side for another boundary.
Wide! Well down the leg side and it is deemed as a wide by the umpire.
FOUR! What a shot! Marvellous timing. Full toss outside off, Sarkar takes it on the full and drives it through the covers and all the way for a boundary. The fielders didn't even move there.

DROPPED! Another opportunity for Windies goes begging. Full and outside off, Das drives this in the air towards cover and Darren Bravo puts his right hand out and tries to take this one but cannot hold on. The ball rolls towards long off for a single.
FOUR! Full, too full outside off. Liton who is in sparkling form this evening, just opens the face of the bat and runs it very fine to the right of the keeper for a boundary.
Full ball on leg stump, Sarkar tries to go for a loft over long on but mistimes it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Bouncer! Das ducks in time to let that one go over him.
Wide down the leg side, No trouble at all for Liton. The umpire has signalled a wide.

FOUR! Shot! Didn't look to hit it hard. Just got to the pitch of it and lofted it over mid off. No protection there and the ball bounces just before the ropes. Fifty for Das. His 2nd in this format. How many more can he make?
Full again outside off, creamed through cover-point to rotate strike.
Down the leg side, Das flicks it off his pads towards fine leg for one.
Full again on middle and leg, Sarkar on-drives it towards mid on to change strike.
Full and outside off, Sarkar drives it crisply but straight to the extra cover fielder.
Carlos Brathwaite in for another spell.
Short ball on the hips, worked away wristily to the deep square leg fielder for a single.

FOUR! Short and punished! It is on middle and Sarkar pulls this away to the left of deep mid-wicket for a boundary. The ball raced away to the fence and there is no chance for the fielder in the deep.
Misfield! The ball is on length outside off, Das pushes it straight to point but Hetmyer at point, completely misses the ball and misfields. A single is taken.
Full and quick at the pads, Soumya doesn't get the ball on his bat properly and it goes onto his pads. The ball rolls onto the off side for a single.
Outside off again, crunched away hard towards the sweeper fielder for another single. It was in the air but well controlled.
Slower ball outside off on a fuller length, driven through the covers for a single.
Keemo Paul is into the attack.
Short ball on middle, pulled away by SS to deep mid-wicket for a single as he keeps strike.
Slower again and Sarkar who is down the ground misses his flick to get hit on the thigh pad.

Goes back short and Das pulls this away in the air to deep mid-wicket for a single. The connection wasn't true enough but that was better for the batsman as the ball doesn't carry to the fielder in the deep.
Slower through the air and on middle, Liton pushes this back watchfully to the bowler.
Short ball on middle again, Liton has enough time to rock back and pull this away wide of mid on for a couple.
Flatter ball on middle and leg, worked towards deep square leg for a single.
The umpire signals the end of the Powerplay.
Nicely done. Very good execution from Oshane. Goes short again outside off, Das tries to cut this but misses it. Nothing from the umpire. Good over the hosts, 14 from it.
No ball! Too high this time. Tries to bang this one hard again but it is well over the batsman's head. Free Hit coming up!!!
Thomas goes short outside off, Das tries to upper cut it but cannot get bat to ball.
SIX! Make that another one. Superb stuff from Liton. Fuller ball again on off, Das gets in position early and paddles this over fine leg over the ropes.
SIX! HUGE! What a fine shot from Liton Das. Overpitched ball in line of the stumps, Das makes room and lofts this over the bowler's head for a biggie.
Fuller on the pads, driven through mid wicket for a single by Sarkar.
Full and outside off, kept out towards point with a punch.
Oshane Thomas returns.
Liton goes for the huge slog sweep but misses this ball completely outside off.
Shorter ball on middle and it is punched back down the ground.

FOUR! Flatter on middle, Das was into position early and sweeps it beautifully over the head of the square leg fielder for a boundary. The deep mid-wicket player almost reached it in time but the ball just had enough to trickle over the fence.

Where was Soumya going! Flatter ball outside off, Liton Das works it on the leg side but straight to square leg. The non-striker wants a single and tries for a quick single and is almost halfway down the pitch when Das sends him back. The throw though is wayward and Sarkar gets back in safely.
Fuller on middle, Sarkar pushes this down the ground and gets off the mark with a single.
Soumya Sarkar is the number 3 batsman.

OUT! Right down mid-wicket's throat! Tamim's struggle comes to an end. He was looking a bit shaky from the start. Short and asking for trouble. Tamim rocks back to pull it but pulls it right into the arms of Cottrell at mid-wicket. Fabian Allen cannot believe his luck. First blood drawn.
Wide! Wide ball to start off, well down the leg side. Good stop by Hope with his right pad.
Fabian Allen is now into the attack.
SIX! back-to-back biggies. A very good end to the over. 13 from it. Carlos drags his length back a bit. Liton charges down the track and slaps this over mid-wicket for half a dozen.
SIX! Easy pickings! This one sits up nicely. It was on the pads, Das just whips it away from his sight and it goes over the fine leg region for a maximum.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg. Das gets a little extra bounce on this. Looks to hook it away but misses it to get hit on his body. No damage done.
Down the leg side, flicked away past square leg for a single.
Around off again, Tamim tries to play it fine past short third man but can't get it past him.
Length ball closer to the off pole, played to the point region.

A dot ball to end the over. Wide outside off, Das times this well off the back foot square on the off side but the point fielder makes a good diving stop to his left and prevents any run. Great over for the hosts, 13 runs off it in the end.
FOUR! Third boundary in four balls. Slower ball on off stump but Liton is quick in reading it and caresses it beautifully through the gap between point and cover for another boundary.
FOUR! The scoop comes out this time, Liton Das takes this almost off his leg stump and puts it very fine on the leg side for four runs.
Full and on middle and leg, driven hard down the ground but Carlos Braithwaite puts a full-length dive to his left to stop what would have been a certain boundary.
FOUR! Short and on middle, Das makes room and slashes it hard over point. The ball is well wide of the third man fielder as it runs into the fence. That's a great shot.

DROPPED! A poor shot and even poorer fielding. The ball was on length and quick outside off, Tamim plays a loose shot and the ball goes straight to Fabian Allen at cover-point. It goes in and out of his hands and the batsmen run through for a single by the time it is collected off the grass. Got to feel bad for Sheldon Cottrell, should have had a wicket there.
Short ball to end the over. Liton ducks under the ball and lets it go through.

Almost had him! Another edge that doesn't go to hand. The ball lands on middle and then moves away late from Tamim. He was looking to play it on the leg side but the ball takes the edge and flies just wide of gully. Single taken.
Outside off on a length ball, defended off the back foot towards the off side.
On the hips again, Tamim connects his nudge better this time and puts it in the gap through mid-wicket for another couple.

Leading edge! The ball was on middle and Tamim closes the face of the bat too quick as he tries to work it away on the leg side. The ball gets the leading edge but goes in the gap between cover and point for a couple.
Drifting on the pads, Das flicks it away in the air but away from the fielder for a single to deep square leg.
Oshane Thomas to bowl from the other end.
Good end to the over by Cottrell. Length ball outside off, Tamim tries to pat it down on the off side and run for a quick single but the fielder is too quick to it. 9 runs off the first over.
Deft on this occasion, length ball outside off, the left-hander just dabs it down wide of slip and the batsmen come back for two by the time the ball is returned by third man.
FOUR! Delightful to watch. A full toss outside off, Tamim takes it on the full and drives it through the covers all the way for a boundary.
Short of a length ball on middle and length, TI works it away in the gap towards mid-wicket for a couple.
Misses out! It was a half-volley outside off, Tamim goes for a huge one over the bowler's head but the ball shapes away in the end and the batsman completely misses the ball. Free Hit wasted.

No ball! The ball seems to have slipped out of Cottrell's hand and it goes on the full to Tamim. The batsman is surprised as the ball hits him at around the waist region. The umpire immediately signals a no ball. It will be a Free Hit the next ball.
Good length outside off, Tamim plays it watchfully towards point.

The two opening batsmen, Tamim Iqbal and Liton Das are walking out to the middle along with the fielders and the two umpires. We are all set to go. Sheldon Cottrell will be bowling the first ball to Tamim.

Shakib Al Hasan the Bangladesh skipper feels that the pitch will suit them more than the visitors and the fact that they have played here more will help them. Says the boys are up for the challenge. Regarding their failure to play bounce well the previous game, he says that the players have enough experience and will look to do better this time around. Signs off by saying that a day or two will not change much and hence they are going with an unchanged line up and looking to put the loss behind them.

Carlos Brathwaite the Windies skipper reckons that the pitch is on the slower side. Says he chose to bowl cause they got success in the previous game defending the target. Mentions that the intent of the first match will be the same and hopes that they cross the line this time as well.

PITCH REPORT - Tino Mawoyo says that the length of boundaries are quite even here on all sides. Looking at the surface that will be used today, he says the surface looks good and there a few cracks along with the pitch being dry. Also adds that the tiny bit of grass will hold the pitch together and the ball will come on to the bat. Feels that the batsmen will enjoy themselves here. Adds that the team winning the toss might like to bat first, with the conditions being lovely for batting.
TOSS - Windies have won the toss and decide that they will chase.

Welcome to the 2nd T20I between Bangladesh and Windies at Dhaka. The visitors absolutely outplayed their opposition in the first game of the series. It was all too easy for them in the format that they favor the most. They first bowled out the hosts cheaply and then, didn't even break a sweat while chasing the total down within 11 overs. Thus, this match is expected to be closer as losing once more will mean that the Bangladeshis lose the series as well. Windies on the other hand, will look to be ruthless as ever. The slower nature of the wicket at the Sher-e-Bangla stadium should hold the home team in good stead and help them more than the Sylhet wicket. We should be in for a cracker of a game! Stay tuned with us, Toss should be here soon.
